en-US.description: The label design software for ComplyPro
en-US.longDescription: The ComplyPro comes with free label design software, ComplyPro Label Designer, allowing you to print from your PC, laptop or as part of a network. You can also design labels and signs in Microsoft Word then print directly to your ComplyPro.
en-US.name: ComplyPro Label Designer
